sources.entry: PDF Archiver - Nice tool for tagging and archiving tasks.

summary.one_liner: PDF Archiver is a macOS and iOS app for archiving scanned documents into a date- and tag-based folder structure so they can be searched easily.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a workflow where scanned bills, letters and similar documents are saved to an untagged folder and then tagged in the PDF Archiver app, which moves them into a year-sorted Archive folder. Files follow a naming convention of yyyy-mm-dd date, a hyphenated description, and double-underscore tags, with capitals, spaces and language-specific characters removed. The README says the structure can be searched by tag (prefix _), by description (prefix -), or by plain search term, and mentions searching file content via Pro Tips. It describes a PDF Archiver for iOS companion that scans documents, performs text recognition, and suggests tags and dates before saving to the archive. The README also lists keyboard use (Tab key for field switching) and points to FAQs for shortcuts.
use_cases: search archived documents by tag or description
scan paper documents on iPhone and file them on Mac
back up or transfer sorted documents to a smartphone
how_to_run: Download PDF Archiver from the App Store
Or clone the repository: git clone (URL not given in README)
Build and run the PDF Archiver target
notable: Companion iOS app for scanning with text recognition and tag/date suggestions
File naming convention: yyyy-mm-dd date, description, and __tags in the filename
Archive structure is independent of OS and filesystem
Search by tag (_), description (-), or plain term
caveats: Primary distribution is the Mac App Store; building from source requires Xcode
README does not specify pricing or whether the app is free
Cloning command in README is incomplete (no URL shown)
